study: qal/lsteer -- steered-inductor drive for the mesh3 three-phase trapezoid wave (trap_tt92_d3, 12.0x per level)

instrument_check.note: all rounded OUT.json fields digit-identical; the single diff is the UNROUNDED handoff/5/4/t_commit_rx_ps raw float, 1679.2738432032 vs 1679.2738431952 ps (8e-9 ps, grid-interpolation float noise between two Xyce runs of the byte-identical deck); PASS at 1e-6 ps tolerance

pre_registered_corrections: DCM L: the brief's 2.2 nH/pair is an arithmetic slip; (92 ps/pi)^2 / 44 fF = 19.5 nH per pair, 9.7 nH at N=2 (corrected in PRE_REGISTERED.json before any deck).

CCM self-sustaining claim: DERIVED-and-WRONG. The plain F->L->R loop's volt-second balance is satisfied for ANY swing equal to the post-handover separation (symmetric trajectories), so it is neutrally stable at best and the series R decays it (measured -11 %/cycle without a zero clamp). The pre-registered 4 ps zero-clamp pulse (L fed from 0 V for 4 ps) adds -5 fWb/third and PINS the current at ~2.5 mA for every seed 2.8/3.15/3.5 mA (converges within one period) -- self-regulating, but to a 0.72 swing with a 450 mV hold-clamp yank.

Constant current UNDER-delivers (independently found by qal/ldrive): C(V) grows as cells turn on and the bank draws its 'hold' current during the rise; a flat 3.5 mA lands 220-450 mV short. The regulator that lands the rail is the 1.65 V in-feed phase of the steered buck (t1 = 0.5-0.6: -31/-122 mV landing).
Terminal capacitance (ASSUMED 20 fF) is not free: the dead-time charge sharing at each handover eats ~0.3 V of separation per side; 5 fF recovers ~60 mV of landing and 16 fJ/bank.
A code bug in the first buck rows (in-feed generated for phase A only) was found from the waveforms and quarantined under runs/BUG_*; those three rows are not scored.

N_sharing.law_as_pre_registered: dI = (1/L) integral(V_L>0) is N-independent -> same ABSOLUTE ripple at fixed L; relative ripple ~1/N; L = L_2 * 2/N for constant relative ripple

measured.note: per-third ripple (max-min inside each 92 ps third, mean of 9 steady thirds). The 3-cycle max-min also contains the secular drift and OVERSTATES ripple (the N8 L120 row: 0.80 mA 3-cycle vs 0.24 mA per third).

N_sharing.inductor_count: ONE inductor per 3-phase group = one per 3N banks (6 banks at N=2, 24 banks at N=8), 12 switches per group (13 with the 1.65 V in-feed), N-invariant.

gate_charge_metered_fC_per_um.nMOS_2p174V: 2.04-2.44 (W=30/10 um, turn-on edge, metered through 0 V gate ammeters)

energy_ledger_summary_fJ_per_bank_per_cy.vs_ledger_240p3: ideal rows +2..+20 %; the DC rail pays the hold charge (~150-185 fC/bank at 1.65 V) plus the landing shortfall; the inductor recycles the rise/fall edges, which the ideal mesh3 rail also recycled -- so the construction cannot beat 240.3, it can only approach it
energy_ledger_summary_fJ_per_bank_per_cy.vs_harmonic_534: ideal rows -46..-54 %; real-switch rows (gate metered) +38..+73 % (736 / 925 fJ) and FAIL anyway

verdict: CAN the 12x wave be driven by a few steered inductors? IN PRINCIPLE YES (ideal-switch BOUND): one inductor per 3N banks, steered F->L->R every third with the holding bank on a 1.65 V DC clamp, sustains the wave in every construction tried -- value 144/144 on P0 and P1, margin 250-697 mV (gate 69.9), overlap 28-41 ps, standing eye 124-137 ps vs 129.0 -- at L = 120 nH (N=2, 6 banks) / 30 nH (N=8, 24 banks) (L = 240 nH/N, sharing law MEASURED: same absolute per-third ripple 0.20 vs 0.24 mA at N=2/N=8 for 120 nH), I0 = 3.5 mA (N=2) / 13.4 mA (N=8) = N x 1.7 mA, ripple 5.8 % per third, at 245-290 fJ/bank/cycle from the DC rail (mesh3 ledger 240.3, harmonic driver 534). BUT the plain loop is NOT self-sustaining (neutral + R decay; a zero-clamp pulse pins it at a 0.72 swing with a 450 mV clamp yank); landing within 0.1 V needs the steered-buck in-feed at t1 = 0.5 (I0 = 4.4 mA, +10 % energy, margin 697 mV, eye 137 ps). DCM (9.7 nH) lands 535 mV short (charge-bound resonant swap, no current zero at the third's end) and degenerates to a 0.84-1.65 V half swing without a clamp. WITH REAL sg13_lv SWITCHES at the binding 2.174 V spec it FAILS: the W=30 um TG's own capacitance (metered 2.1-3.0 fC/um per edge) loads each phase node with ~250-300 fF (as much as the bank pair), the rails swing only 0.65-1.78 V, value fails 6-7/144; re-seeded wider rows (W=50/78 um, 7-9 mA) crash Xyce at the first high-current handover (-240 mA crowbar into vddh through the pMOS wells once the rail exceeds 1.65 V). No real-switch operating point was found; the gate bill alone is 328 (nMOS) / 495 (TG) fJ/bank metered, so even a working real version would sit at ~740-925 fJ/bank, above the 534 fJ harmonic driver. Energy REPORTED, never gated.
